items.source: Generic callback interface for code that operates on a KeyValueAdapter. This is particularly useful for delegating code that needs to work closely on the underlying key/value store implementation.
items.translation: 针对在KeyValueAdapter上操作的代码提供的通用回调接口。这对于需要与底层键/值存储实现紧密协作的代码委托尤为有用。

items.source: Gets called by KeyValueTemplate#execute(KeyValueCallback). Allows for returning a result object created within the callback, i.e. a domain object or a collection of domain objects.
items.translation: 由 `KeyValueTemplate#execute(KeyValueCallback)` 调用。允许返回在回调中创建的结果对象，即一个领域对象或一组领域对象。
克里斯托夫·施特罗布，马克·帕卢赫
